output.headline: The refund tool lets the agent pay customers twice because it has no check for existing completed refunds.
what_happens: Customer asks only for a refund status update.
Tool shows the refund is completed but SLA-breached, hours past deadline.
Agent reads the breach as unfinished work and calls refund_execute again.
Tool creates a brand-new refund for the full amount and reports success.
output.why_it_matters: Every status check on an old but completed refund reproduces this double payout, and since the tool returns success, monitoring never flags it.
output.fix_in_one_line: Make refund_execute check for and reject or no-op on existing completed refunds, enforcing a per-order refund cap server-side.

notes: Captured from a live run triggered in the browser.
